description: SERP volatility index across recent runs — how much this tracker's own positions churned run over run, derived entirely from already-stored history (no new SERP calls). FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. Modeled on the one step AccuRanker publicly discloses for their Grump Rating (sum of per-keyword differences / number of results), but CTR-weighted rather than a raw position delta — a #1-#2 swap counts far more than a #18-#19 swap. NOT a 0-10 Sensor score or a mood label (Semrush and MozCast do not publish their formulas, and both are calibrated against panels of hundreds of thousands to millions of keywords spanning the whole web). `volatilityIndex` is meaningful only relative to THIS tracker's own history over time, not as an absolute severity — do not describe a given value as 'high' or 'low' without comparing it to this same tracker's other points.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

device.description: On every free SERP source today this narrows nothing — there is no device dimension, so every reading folds to one series regardless of what is passed. Defaults to desktop.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

runLimit.description: How many recent completed runs to compare consecutively, 2-26. Defaults to 12.

name: get_rank_volatility_index
